Pending hardware validation: flash SD and confirm UART log uses External DMA and no mmc0 -110.

title: Investigate tiny kernel memory protection warning
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warning: Kernel memory protection not selected by kernel config. Determine exact kernel source path, Kconfig symbols involved, security/runtime impact on ARM AM335x tiny image, size/performance tradeoff, and whether a safe tiny-only config fix exists before changing code.
notes: Root cause: init/main.c mark_readonly() prints 'Kernel memory protection not selected by kernel config.' when CONFIG_ARCH_HAS_STRICT_KERNEL_RWX=y but CONFIG_STRICT_KERNEL_RWX is not set. Current tiny generated .config has ARMv7/MMU support and ARCH_OPTIONAL_KERNEL_RWX_DEFAULT=y, but CONFIG_STRICT_KERNEL_RWX is unset. Standard BBB linux-yocto config has CONFIG_STRICT_KERNEL_RWX=y and CONFIG_STRICT_MODULE_RWX=y. Repo phase1 policy currently includes ktypes/tiny/yocto.cfg and does not include the broader kernel-meta security feature that would enable STRICT_KERNEL_RWX. Effect if enabled on ARM: mark text/rodata read-only and non-text memory non-executable via arch/arm/mm/init.c; non-LPAE ARM uses 1MiB section alignment, so size/layout overhead must be measured with a build before fixing. CONFIG_MODULES is disabled, so STRICT_MODULE_RWX is currently not applicable. Recommended next step: add a tiny-specific hardening fragment with CONFIG_STRICT_KERNEL_RWX=y only, build, compare zImage/vmlinux size, then boot-check that the warning disappears and no new debug_checkwx/errors appear.

title: Investigate tiny TPS65217 PMIC of_node warning
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warning: tps65217-pmic: Failed to locate of_node [id: -1]. Determine exact kernel source path, TPS65217 MFD/PMIC child relationship, DT nodes involved, runtime impact on regulators/power, and whether a safe tiny-only fix exists.
notes: Root cause confirmed: TPS65217 regulator binding defines regulator constraints under the parent tps@24 regulators container; no binding or DTS source defines a ti,tps65217-pmic child. The warning comes from drivers/mfd/tps65217.c giving the tps65217-pmic MFD cell an of_compatible, causing mfd-core to search for a nonexistent child node. Implemented a narrow kernel patch removing only that PMIC cell OF match while keeping the platform device name used by the regulator driver. Verified by make yocto-build YOCTO_IMAGE=core-image-optimal-tiny-initramfs; 1940 tasks succeeded. Hardware boot-log confirmation still pending.
close_reason: User-provided fresh BBB UART boot log confirms the TPS65217 PMIC of_node warning and both ti-sysc device-link warning lines are absent. PMIC still probes, I2C/UART/SD continue to work, and mmc0 enumerates the SD card.

title: Investigate tiny ti-sysc device-link warnings
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warnings: ti-sysc 44e31000.target-module and 48040000.target-module Failed to create device link (0x180) with ocp. Determine kernel source path, DT nodes involved, whether this is caused by tiny DT pruning, runtime impact, and whether a safe tiny-only fix exists.
notes: Implemented a tiny linux-yocto kernel patch that demotes fw_devlink device-link failures only when the attempted link has DL_FLAG_SYNC_STATE_ONLY. Evidence: source audit shows the visible flags 0x180 are DL_FLAG_SYNC_STATE_ONLY | DL_FLAG_INFERRED, so the failed link is sync-state-only and does not enforce probe ordering or runtime PM. The patch preserves dev_err for non-SYNC_STATE_ONLY device-link failures. Yocto build verification passed: make yocto-build YOCTO_IMAGE=core-image-optimal-tiny-initramfs completed 1940 tasks successfully. Work-shared kernel source contains the new dev_dbg string 'Skipped sync-state-only device link'. Pending external validation: flash/boot on BBB and confirm the two ti-sysc Failed to create device link lines are absent while timer, UART, and SD still work.
close_reason: User-provided fresh BBB UART boot log confirms the TPS65217 PMIC of_node warning and both ti-sysc device-link warning lines are absent. PMIC still probes, I2C/UART/SD continue to work, and mmc0 enumerates the SD card.

title: Investigate tiny pinmux OCP dependency cycle warning
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warning: /ocp/.../pinmux@800: Fixed dependency cycle(s) with /ocp/interconnect@44c00000. Determine exact kernel source path, DT properties forming the cycle, relation to ti-sysc device-link warnings, runtime impact, and whether a safe fix exists before changing code.
notes: Fixed in tiny DTS by deleting inherited pinctrl-names/pinctrl-0 from &am33xx_pinmux. Build verification: make yocto-build YOCTO_IMAGE=core-image-optimal-tiny-initramfs completed successfully, 1940 tasks attempted and all succeeded. DTB verification: decompiled deploy DTB shows pinmux@800 no longer has pinctrl-names or pinctrl-0, while child pin states such as uart0-pins and clkout2-pins remain present. Expected hardware verification: after flashing the rebuilt SD image, boot log should no longer print the pinmux@800 Fixed dependency cycle warning; UART and SD should still work.
close_reason: Fixed in tiny DTS and verified by Yocto build plus decompiled deploy DTB; hardware boot log confirmation remains the external validation step.

title: Investigate tiny OMAP voltage late init warning
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warning: omap_voltage_late_init: Voltage driver support not added. Determine exact source path, kernel config/DT dependency, AM335x relevance, whether this is a functional issue or legacy init noise, and whether a safe fix exists before changing code.
notes: Implemented a targeted linux-yocto-tiny patch that skips legacy omap_voltage_late_init() on AM33xx/AM43xx. Root cause: AM33xx builds common voltage.o/vc.o/vp.o but has no voltagedomains33xx_data.c, so voltdm_list is empty. Yocto build core-image-optimal-tiny-initramfs passed; hardware boot-log confirmation is still pending.
close_reason: Fixed by commit 369793f. User-provided fresh BBB UART boot log confirms omap_voltage_late_init warning is absent; kernel boots and SD enumerates.

title: Investigate tiny MMC pbias and vqmmc supply warnings
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warnings from sdhci-omap: supply pbias not found, using dummy regulator and supply vqmmc not found, using dummy regulator. Determine exact driver source, DTS binding expectations, AM335x/BBB hardware model, impact on SD-only and future eMMC flows, and whether a safe patch exists before changing code.
notes: pbias portion resolved: added Yocto kernel patch for sdhci-omap capability probing to use regulator_get_optional() instead of regulator_get(). Full make yocto-build YOCTO_IMAGE=core-image-optimal-tiny-initramfs passed. User boot log confirms pbias and vqmmc dummy-regulator warnings are absent, while mmc0 still enumerates as high speed SDHC.
close_reason: Resolved vqmmc via fixed 3.3V IO rail DT modeling and pbias via optional regulator lookup in sdhci-omap capability probing; build and board boot log verified.

title: Disable unused TPS65217 backlight child in tiny DTS
description: Tiny BBB boot logs show tps65217-bl: Failed to locate of_node [id: -1]. Investigation found backlight is unused in UART+SD tiny flow and CONFIG_BACKLIGHT_CLASS_DEVICE is disabled. Add an explicit disabled TPS65217 backlight child node in the tiny DTS so the MFD core can skip this unused cell without changing PMIC/regulator support.
close_reason: Added a disabled TPS65217 backlight child node to the tiny DTS only. Verified Yocto tiny image build succeeded and deployed DTB contains backlight compatible ti,tps65217-bl with status disabled under tps@24. PMIC/regulator support remains unchanged.

title: Investigate TPS65217 MFD of_node warnings
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warnings: tps65217-pmic: Failed to locate of_node [id: -1] and tps65217-bl: Failed to locate of_node [id: -1]. Determine exact source, DTS relationship, runtime impact, and whether a fix is safe before changing code.
close_reason: Investigated TPS65217 MFD of_node warnings. Root cause is MFD child cells tps65217-pmic and tps65217-bl having of_compatible values without matching child nodes in BBB DTB. Regulator support still uses parent tps node plus regulators container; backlight is not enabled in tiny kernel config. Recommendation: do not patch now; treat as non-functional boot-log noise unless enabling backlight/charger/powerbutton features later.

title: Silence invalid MMC card-detect debounce on tiny BBB DTS
description: Tiny BBB boot logs show omap_gpio 44e07000.gpio: Could not set line 6 debounce to 200000 microseconds (-22). Kernel source shows MMC defaults cd-debounce-delay-ms to 200ms when absent, then calls gpiod_set_debounce for the cd-gpios line. The tiny DTS should explicitly set cd-debounce-delay-ms to 0 for mmc1 so card-detect remains configured without requesting unsupported hardware debounce.
close_reason: Implemented tiny DTS override cd-debounce-delay-ms=<0> for mmc1. Verified Yocto tiny image build succeeded and deployed DTB contains cd-debounce-delay-ms = 0 with cd-gpios preserved.

title: Disable tiny U-Boot watchdog log
description: Tiny U-Boot Phase 1 should be MMC-only and serial-only with minimal boot noise. U-Boot proper still auto-starts the OMAP watchdog and prints WDT: Started even though SPL WDT and CMD_WDT are off. Disable the U-Boot watchdog surface only for beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny while preserving extlinux boot behavior.
notes: Approved decision: disable U-Boot proper watchdog entirely for beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny. Patched tiny-deterministic.cfg to unset WATCHDOG, WATCHDOG_AUTOSTART, WDT, and WDT_OMAP3; updated docs/boot-contract.md to include U-Boot watchdog servicing in tiny removed surface. Yocto tiny build passes; generated .config has WATCHDOG/WDT disabled. Pending UART proof after flashing rebuilt artifacts.
close_reason: Fresh UART proof shows tiny U-Boot no longer starts or logs U-Boot watchdog servicing; boot continues through /extlinux/extlinux.conf, /zImage, and the tiny DTB.

title: Disable tiny U-Boot watchdog log
description: Tiny U-Boot already boots serial/MMC-only and no longer needs U-Boot watchdog runtime servicing in Phase 1. The remaining WDT: Started line adds non-essential boot noise, so disable watchdog only for beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny while preserving bootcmd/extlinux behavior.

title: Clean up tiny U-Boot network and USB gadget boot noise
description: Fix only the approved beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny U-Boot cleanup: make tiny U-Boot MMC-only and serial-only while preserving extlinux.conf as Linux payload source of truth. Do not touch Linux kernel config, tiny DTS, baseline path, mmc0 -110, or eMMC flow.
notes: Fresh UART after ARCH_MISC_INIT fix now reaches autoboot, but bootcmd passed relative extlinux/extlinux.conf to sysboot. U-Boot pxe_setup_ctx derives bootdir from bootfile, so sysboot tried extlinux/extlinux/extlinux.conf and failed. Changed tiny bootcmd to pass absolute /extlinux/extlinux.conf. Yocto tiny build passes; generated .config has absolute path, ARCH_MISC_INIT off, NET/USB/EFI off. Pending SD flash/UART proof.
close_reason: Fresh UART proof shows tiny U-Boot MMC/extlinux boot works and removed noise is absent: no ethaddr/Net/RNDIS/usb_ether, no initcall failure, no bad extlinux path, and no U-Boot WDT log.
